summary: This is a routine 6-K report by Central North Airport Group (OMA) for the month of June 2026, filed under Rule 13a-16. The filing discloses a 3.6% decrease in terminal passenger traffic for May 2026 compared to May 2025, with domestic traffic up 4.7% and international traffic down 2.8%. It notes one new route and standard contact details. The report contains no special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or corporate action. It is an ordinary operational update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic changes.
